INDIA bloc MPs meet President Murmu, demand return to ballot papers

A delegation of INDIA bloc Members of Parliament met with President Droupadi Murmu at Rashtrapati Bhavan on Tuesday evening. The MPs presented a memorandum to the President, demanding a return to ballot papers for elections instead of Electronic Voting Machines (EVMs). Some leaders of the INDIA bloc were reportedly stopped at Vijay Chowk while attempting to reach Rashtrapati Bhavan.
